sentences.text: The petitioner has filed the above Writ Petition praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus to direct the respondents to consider the representation, dated 02.01.2018 submitted by the petitioner seeking for re-conveyance of the land survey No.281/4, measuring 0.11.0 ares in Kalamarudhur Post, Ulundurpet Taluk, Villupuram District.
2. This is a petition for re-conveyance of the land in question.

The main contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that though the land was acquired by G.O.95, Social Welfare Department, dated 18.01.1989, the said G.O. was challenged before this Court earlier in W.P.No.5385 of 1995 and by order dated 08.08.2001, this Court had quashed the said G.O., with liberty to the petitioners therein to initiate fresh proceedings under the Tamil Nadu Act 31 of 1978.
Subsequently, the respondents have not taken any steps and the adjacent land owners got re-conveyance.

Therefore, since the acquisition proceedings have been quashed, the land has to be re-conveyed to the petitioner.
3.

When this Writ Petition came up for hearing on 06.02.2024, this Court directed the respondents to report as to whether, after the order passed by this Court on 08.08.2001, they have issued any fresh proceedings for acquisition or not.

When the matter is listed today, the learned Additional Government Pleader https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Order dated 14.02.2024 is not in a position to show that subsequent to the quashing of the declaration under Section 6-A of the Act 31 of 1978,
they have proceeded with the acquisition proceedings afresh.

Therefore, in the above circumstances,
this Court had already quashed the acquisition proceedings in W.P.No.5385 of 1995, as noted above,
and in any scheme for Adi Dravidar Community, the official respondents have colluded with the land owners and one way or the other, they were frustrating any beneficial scheme introduced or the project of the Adi Dravidar Welfare Community, by either they purposely makes the mistake and allow the Court to quash the Notification/Declaration.

If the Court, on some technical grounds,
quashed the acquisition proceedings and gave liberty to proceed afresh, the official respondents have never did the same.

Again, they are colluding with the land owners and they are not proceeding with the fresh acquisition process and take effective steps to implement the welfare scheme of the Government.
4.

Therefore, this Court has already issued direction in W.P.No.5385 of 1995 with liberty to go ahead with the fresh acquisition proceedings, but from 2001 to 2014, for the past 23 years, the respondents have not taken any steps for fresh acquisition and inviting the land owners to file a Writ Petition once again now, for either re-conveyance or automatically getting lapse under Section 24(2) of the new Land Acquisition Act of 2013, for paying the compensation https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Order dated 14.02.2024 under the new Act, which clearly shows that the Land Acquisition Officers either are not interested to acquire the land and provide the land to landless Adi Dravidar people for S.Narasammal vs The Government Of Tamil Nadu on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84835452/
2 house-site, or they colluded with the land owners one way or the other and safe-guard the interest of the land owner and not to show the interest on implementing the schemes of the Government.

sentences.text: Therefore, the action of the second respondent is highly deprecated.
Therefore, this Writ Petition is also be posted along with the Writ Petition in W.P.No.32485 of 2023, dated 30.01.2024.

Since the second respondent herein has not taken any action, the innocent landless poor should not suffer and therefore, the Chief Secretary to Government, Secretariat, Chennai, is directed to take departmental action against the second and third respondents herein, since the respondents 2 and 3 have entered into a conspiracy with the land owner and not implementing the schemes of the Government and also comply with the order of the Court stated supra.

5. Since the official respondents are colluding with the petitioner and they have not followed the procedures contemplated under law, even after this Court gave liberty to proceed afresh, they are not entitled to the relief sought for.
6. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed.
No costs.

7. Already, this Court gave a direction to the CBI to conduct enquiry and this writ petition be also tagged along with W.P.No.32485 of 2023 (order dated https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Order dated 14.02.2024 30.01.2024) for conducting enquiry by the CBI and to file investigation report as stipulated in the above said W.P.No.32485 of 2023.

In this context, it is worthwhile to extract the directions issued in W.P.No.32485 of 2023, which reads as follows:
"8.

Admittedly, this Court passed the order on 30.03.2001, but till date, the respondents have not taken any steps to issue fresh Notification to implement the scheme, which clearly shows that the officials of the respondents have not shown any interest to implement any scheme introduced by the Government, especially for Adi-Dravidar Community.

Though the Government have taken much efforts to do certain welfare measurements to the needy people, but unfortunately, the officials are holding the said schemes reluctantly, which shows the lethargic attitude to implement the welfare scheme, especially for the members of the Adi-Dravidar Community.
This case is one of the examples for the same.

The attitude of the officials is shocking the conscience of this Court, and therefore, this Court directs the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) to register a case and investigate the matter and also submit a report as to whether the non initiation of the fresh notification /
acquisition proceedings as per the order of this Court, dated 30.03.2001 is only https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Order dated 14.02.2024 inadvertent or intentional and is there any conspiracy between the officials and the land owners.

Further CBI is directed to investigate how many welfare schemes of Adi-Dravidar Community are pending for implementing the cases of this nature and register a case and conduct the investigation and file a report within a period of one year, i.e. on or before 30.01.2025."
8. List this Writ Petition along with W.P.No.32485 of 2023 in the caption "for reporting compliance"
31.01.2025.
